name: Clarice
epithet: Shuffled Capitals & Glass Urns of Lost First Splendor
anti_trude_vector: Stratified spolia palimpsest & irreversible epoch-permutation collider where nine indestructible Calvino relics causally exchange sacred Museum vitrines and beggar chicken-run utilities across plague-chrysalis and butterfly-splendor cycles while first-origin proof remains impossible.

ontological_invariants.principle: There was no proving that a first Clarice had existed: the order of the eras' succession was lost; total shard mass is strictly conserved while reverence and utility permute across plagues and butterfly-splendor surges.
